name: George F. Adams
milestones: Born 18 Mar 1887, Kansas City, Jackson County, MO
Died 29 Oct 1941, Kansas City, Jackson County, MO
career: Clerk for Martin, Bloomquist, and Lee Commission Company
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Son of Col. Alexander William Adams, born 1887. Not one of the George Francis Adams line.
